title: Impact of Climate Change on Water & Food Security in Cameroon
description:
Prerequisite: Enrolled in or completed Fundamental Studies Professional Writing (FSPW).
Restriction: Must have earned at least 60 credits.
Jointly offered with: GBHL642.
Credit only granted for: GBHL442 or GBHL449A or GBHL642.
Formerly: GBHL449A.
Additional information: This is a Global Classrooms course, developed in partnership with the Office of International Affairs (OIA) to provide virtual opportunities for global engagement. Learn more about Global Classrooms: go.umd.edu/gc-umd.
